ideas.title: Investigating Excessive Use of Force by Federal Agents in Minnesota
ideas.description: This story would investigate the circumstances surrounding the fatal shooting of Alex Pretti and explore the broader pattern of excessive use of force by federal agents in Minnesota
questions: What were the circumstances surrounding the shooting?
Is there a pattern of excessive use of force by federal agents in Minnesota?
ideas.insight: This story has the potential to uncover a larger pattern of misconduct by federal agents in Minnesota, which could have significant implications for police accountability and public trust.
